study: Source-resolved tissue-frame displacement-lag information test with fixed emission count
weak_wall_selection: Evaluator only: eight of 16 fixed near-wall pixels with lowest source blood/tissue power in the matched first eight cycles; noise is excluded to pair the identical pixel set across schedules; fixed before scoring new RF
feature: absolute normalized complex covariance at lag 1 within a burst minus real normalized covariance at lag 48, evaluated after observed-mixture B-mode translation and global IQ phase registration
interpretation: Source AUC, known-direction velocity search, and first-cycle-repeated static-blood IQ counterfactual are evaluator-only information diagnostics; no truth enters the fixed score or B-mode/IQ alignment. The burst schedule changes observation duration and timing, not emission count. Near-wall source separability alone cannot certify mixture-domain filtering. The acoustic model excludes reverberation and wall reflectors.
